lines: A password alone no longer opens the admin console. Staff now confirm it's them, with a code from their phone.
After the password, staff open their authenticator app and enter the six-digit code. While it's checked, the button says Verifying, then the Dashboard opens.
A wrong code is said under the field, which keeps what was typed and takes focus. Codes change every thirty seconds, so enter the newest one.
After five wrong codes in fifteen minutes, the sign-in ends. Wait more than five minutes, and you're asked to sign in again.
Staff without an authenticator are told to ask an Admin, who sets one up with a single command.
On the server, the right password starts no session, only a short pending sign-in. A used code is refused, and no code or secret is ever recorded.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
That's slice nine point two. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
